risk.insecure_skip_verify: Certificate risk warning: this node is configured to skip TLS certificate verification, so the connection can be intercepted by a man-in-the-middle. Do not use it unless you fully trust the node provider.
risk.node_trust: Trust note: a proxy node's operator can in principle observe the destinations and any unencrypted content of traffic relayed through it. Only use nodes you trust, and never send sensitive information through an untrusted node.
risk.vpngate.body: VPN Gate is an academic experiment project of the University of Tsukuba, and its nodes are provided by volunteers around the world. Under its official policy, connection logs are kept for three months or more and may be disclosed as required by law, and a node operator can access any unencrypted traffic relayed through their node. This source is suitable for general reachability, not for highly sensitive use. These nodes run on volunteers' personal computers and networks, not on commercial servers; a volunteer operator may also record packet logs of the traffic relayed through their device (kept for two weeks or more under their policy, shown per node in the list). Such logs may be disclosed when police or a court legally requires it. Treat this source as a reachability tool for getting connected, not as a privacy tool: do not send account passwords, financial information, or other highly sensitive content through it.
risk.vpngate.confirm: I have read and understood these risks — enable VPN Gate
risk.vpngate.node_line: Volunteer node (VPN Gate): the operator may log connections and traffic and may disclose logs as required by law. Not for sensitive use.
risk.vpngate.revoke: Revoke my acknowledgement and disable VPN Gate
risk.vpngate.title: Risk notice before enabling VPN Gate
risk.weak_encryption: Weak encryption warning: this node uses a legacy weak cipher (non-AEAD, such as the cfb family or rc4-md5) with insufficient confidentiality. It is importable only for compatibility with existing subscriptions. Prefer an AEAD node; auto-selection will not recommend weak nodes first.

security.no_passphrase_warning: No passphrase set: the configuration is stored unencrypted on this device. Anyone who can read the file can see your node credentials; consider enabling passphrase encryption in Settings.

update.auto_check: Check for updates periodically (at most once every 24 hours)
update.err_download: The update download failed. Check your connection and try again.
update.err_fetch: Could not fetch update information. Check your connection and try again.
update.err_hash: Update verification failed: the package does not match the official release record. It was deleted and will not be installed.
update.err_install: Installation did not complete. Your current version is unaffected and keeps working.
update.err_install_unavailable: In-app installation is not available on this platform yet. The new package was downloaded and its signature verified — run it manually to install, or download it from the official site.
update.err_invalid: The update information received was corrupted and has been ignored.
update.err_no_artifact: The new version does not ship a package for this platform yet. Try again later or download it from the official site.
update.err_rollback: The update information received was abnormal (release sequence went backwards) and has been rejected. Please verify the latest version on the official site.
update.err_signature: The update package failed signature verification. It was deleted and will not be installed. Never install packages from untrusted sources.
update.privacy_note: Checking for updates only fetches a version manifest from the official release channel. It sends the app name and version only — no device information. The server will see your network address.
update.ready: The new package has been downloaded and its signature verified.
update.title: Software update
update.up_to_date: You are on the latest version.
warn.weak_auto_note: Note: nodes marked "Weak encryption" are deprioritized by auto-selection and are only chosen when no other working node exists in the group.
